annotation.title_clean: 关于开展2026年度中央财政支持实施城市更新行动的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Carrying Out the 2026 Central Government Fiscal Support for Implementing Urban Renewal Action
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 财政部办公厅; 住房城乡建设部办公厅 (Ministry of Finance General Office; Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development General Office)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Finance and MOHURD notice launching the 2026 competitive selection of up to 15 cities for central fiscal subsidies for urban renewal. It sets eligibility, selection procedure, subsidy caps by region, funding directions, and performance monitoring. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Up to 15 prefecture-level or higher cities selected competitively; one nominee per province.
Fixed central subsidies capped at 8/10/12 billion yuan for eastern/central/western cities.
Funds support model urban renewal districts and mechanism building.
Cities must avoid new hidden government debt and duplicate central funding.
Applications due 8 May 2026; performance evaluation and annual tracking required.
